name: NestList
access: OML creates this object from a selector:NestList node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: el
properties.description: Element that holds the component. Required.

properties.name: list
properties.description: Items. Each item has title, an optional scope array, and open. Optional.

properties.name: map
properties.description: Property map for title and scope. Optional.

properties.name: order
properties.description: Titles that must stay in this order. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
